svg.title: Szekszárd study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Szekszárd; 2: Görögszó; 3: Sióagárd; 4: Szálka; 5: Bátaszék; 6: Mórágy; 7: Mőcsény; 8: Várdomb; 9: Pécs

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
